items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: the oldest son was named Sidney Pittman

ctx.x: in the public high school. They named the school after Booker T. Washington. I went to Booker T. Washington High School in Dallas, Texas. And she was the music teacher. She taught voice, but she spoke seven languages fluently, because she had studied all over the world, Berlin Conservatory of Music, every place she had gone.

And she came back to Dallas and married, and had these kids. She had one kid, the oldest son was named Sidney Pittman. Then Booker was next, who was my age. And then they had one daughter -- what was the daughter's first name? Fanny, Fanny Pittman. Fanny was a beautiful piano player. The oldest brother, he went to Washington, D. C. later on in life and was working for the United States Post Office. He had an injury in his back and was like a vegetable. He became a vegetable, and was drawing a pension, and he was…
I notice most of these Booker T. Washington family names have a lot of Indian things in them, Taliaferro, and --
